title: Page kinds and their structure — living-docs capability
description: Formal shape of the capability's `schemas/page-kinds.yaml`: each page kind it ships, keyed by the kind a page names in its `kind` field, with the structure the kind's pages follow (living-docs DEC-001 point 3; RS-LDOC-004) — the sections a page's body carries, in order unless the kind says otherwise. The one declaration of each kind's structure. The validator, `pkit living-docs validate`, checks a page of the kind against it where RS-LDOC-004 binds on the page, as `pkit rule-sets reach` gives it (living-docs DEC-001 point 3; COR-051 point 7), and there a departure is an error. A kind not listed declares no structure, so a page of it where the rule binds is reported with its kind, never failed. No other page's body is checked, and under any status but accepted the rule binds on none. A structure names only what every page of the kind must carry. Capability data, read by the capability's own scripts; not adopter data.

kinds.description: The page kinds, keyed by kind; each kind's template is `templates/<kind>.md`.

word.description: A page kind, as a page's `kind` field names it (`schemas/page.schema.json`).

sections.description: The sections every page of the kind carries. Each takes a heading of its own; a page may carry other sections besides.

ordered.description: Whether the sections come in the order listed. True unless set to false.

section.title: One section: a heading's level and, where the kind fixes it, its text
section.description: A heading written with one to six `#` at the start of a line, outside fenced code and HTML comments. A section without `text` is one the writer words — a heading with words of its own, not an empty one or a template's unfilled `<placeholder>`; text is compared ignoring case, runs of white space and trailing punctuation.

level.description: The heading's level: the number of `#`.
